definitions: A factory where natural gas is processed and purified.
A perennial herbaceous plant (Dictamnus albus) native to Eurasia, known for its fragrant flowers and leaves that can release flammable volatile oils.
examples: The new gas plant will increase energy production.
She planted a gas plant in her garden.
Workers at the gas plant went on strike.
The gas plant is known for its citrus-scented flowers.
